toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We observed a high rate of outbound HTTP errors (64%) to partner integrations. The partner-sync service showed DNS resolution errors (EAI_AGAIN) for partners.acme-logistics.com. We have restarted the partner-sync service to clear potential DNS cache or transient issues. Monitoring continues."}

response.text: The alert indicated a 64% error rate for outbound HTTP requests to partners. I checked the outbound_http_errors metric and confirmed the high error rate. Logs from the partner-sync service showed DNS resolution errors (EAI_AGAIN) for partners.acme-logistics.com. To remediate, I restarted the partner-sync service to clear any DNS cache or transient issues. I also posted a status update to inform customers of the situation and ongoing monitoring.
